import_neonplan.title: Import your NeonPlan floor plan
import_neonplan.description: Presence Planner no longer reads NeonPlan 3D live. Open NeonPlan 3D, export the floor plan or a backup as a file, then open the Presence Planner panel and choose **Import**. Your sensors and settings come back with it.
